International

Professional Partnerships in Türkiye’s Healthcare Sector

Consulting on professional business development and corporate communication between healthcare organisations in Türkiye and international business partners.

Local insight, international perspective

The right partnerships begin with mutual understanding and trust.

For international organisations looking to work with healthcare organisations in Türkiye, a counterpart who knows the local sector plays an important role in keeping the process on track.

From our base in Bursa, we support professional communication between healthcare organisations in Türkiye and international partners, help clarify mutual expectations, and structure business development processes.

How we support

For international business partners.

Introductions

Establishing contact with healthcare organisations in Türkiye through professional, appropriate channels.

Corporate communication

Maintaining clear, consistent and professional communication between the parties.

Sector and market insight

Sharing insight into how the Turkish healthcare sector works and into regional conditions.

Business development

Structuring partnership and collaboration processes in line with shared goals.

Scope

A clear, transparent definition of services.

Our international services consist of consulting on business development and corporate communication between organisations.

Important informationWe do not provide patient admission, treatment arrangement, medical tourism brokerage or patient referral services. For individual healthcare needs, please contact the relevant healthcare provider directly.

Let’s work together

Planning a partnership in Türkiye?

Tell us briefly about your organisation and your goals, and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
